shortDescription: An invisible-when-worn Blåhaj plush in the Utility storage category, plush furnishings, and a craftable stone Blåhaj sculpture.
body: Adds three fabric/leather Blåhaj plush items using the supplied shark texture. The wearable is apparel assigned to the Belt layer (RimWorld utility slot), categorized as ApparelUtility for storage filtering, crafted at hand or electric tailoring benches, requires Complex Clothing research, and provides +10% LearningRateFactor and +0.05 Comfort while equipped; its wornGraphicPath is empty to suppress pawn rendering. Two fabric/leather furniture decorations are crafted at tailoring benches, require Complex Clothing, and add Beauty 10 (one tile) or Beauty 20 (three tiles). The larger building is rotatable and has footprint (3,1), so its occupied footprint rotates with building orientation. Both furniture defs use MinifiedThing so they can be moved/stored. Adds a one-tile Blåhaj stone statue inheriting vanilla's abstract SculptureBase. It is a Building_Art using the sculptor's table and artistic work; it requires 50 units of stony stuff and has small-sculpture-style stats, with its own custom texture.
